label: Different sources of protection for reliance
explanation: Drennan addresses a general contractor’s reliance on a subcontractor’s bid and the resulting limitation on revocation in that setting. Administrative review requires an agency changing policy to address serious reliance interests when the governing reasoned-decisionmaking analysis demands it. These accounts show why a decisionmaker should identify the reliance and the rule that gives it legal significance. Agency reliance review does not import promissory estoppel or make every prior policy irrevocable.
